enemy_class_notes: Static map markers describe encounter loci, not a guaranteed spawned enemy tier.
Elite is a runtime stronger variant with additional affixes; no static E marker is emitted.
Operatives are co-op-only runtime enemies and therefore have no static map marker.
Mutation Agent is labeled A only for an exact authored actor; campaign horde anchors do not imply one.
Captain boss pits occur outside X-4; X-4 boss pits contain Destructors.

enemies.name: Swarming Herbipod
descriptions: Stationary until threatened; launches slow, relentlessly homing attacks.
enemies.behavior: Zero locomotion keeps the turret stationary, its aggro presentation activates it, and its bounded projectile uses delayed retained-target homing with terminal cleanup even when the target becomes invalid or takes no damage.

enemies.name: Pathogenic Vegevore
descriptions: Disease projectile can jump between nearby heroes.

enemies.name: Botanical Tunneler
descriptions: Tunnels close underground, then emerges with a poison area attack.
enemies.behavior: Its burrow animation and temporary intangibility accompany pursuit into the eight-unit radial Stagnant Nova.

enemies.name: Mending Tanglid
descriptions: Heals badly hurt allies; roots heroes, calls nearby friends to attack them, and keeps away from heroes.
enemies.behavior: Its strict-below-half support branch heals first, its repeated close-range retreat keeps separation, and Entangle applies the ranked root and redirects all living allies inside 20 units to that victim.

enemies.name: Grappling Pulsar
descriptions: Pull victims are slowed, then struck with rapid melee attacks.
enemies.behavior: The three-second Pulled modifier owns the forced-movement interval, then the phase uses the recovered nine-hit Fast Swipe while Puller cools.

enemies.name: Toxiraptor
descriptions: Connected melee attacks can inject poison.
enemies.behavior: Every accepted surviving hit rolls the ranked chance and applies or refreshes the authored damage-over-time modifier.

enemies.name: Hypno Mantis
descriptions: Lobs a small sleeping cloud, then closes on sleeping heroes for a melee swipe.
enemies.behavior: Sleep Mushroom creates the three-tick radius-two cloud and close targets switch to Rez Melee.

enemies.name: Dynosphere
descriptions: Straightforward melee protected by a periodically recharging absorption shield.
enemies.behavior: Its frontal melee is unchanged and its visible rank-shaped absorption shield recharges after 12/10/8 seconds.

enemies.name: Fragbot Mech
descriptions: Highly resistant to energy damage; attacks with rapid-fire machine guns.
enemies.behavior: It publishes rank-shaped 250/500/750 Energy Defense and fires its recovered five-shot burst.

enemies.name: Reconstructionist
descriptions: Ground slam knocks nearby heroes upward; when damaged, repairs itself.
enemies.behavior: Its phase chooses ranked self-repair while wounded, otherwise radial Ground Slam or close Piston Punch.

enemies.name: Reparatron
descriptions: Repairs fallen robots and can use its tools as melee weapons.

enemies.name: Pack Brawler
descriptions: Cowers alone and uses powerful melee when an ally is nearby.

enemies.name: Raytheoid
descriptions: Piercing lasers cross multiple heroes; buffs nearby allies’ energy damage.
enemies.behavior: The piercing path damages each contact once and resolves at the selected target, while the support branch applies one ranked Energy Damage buff per 30-second modifier cycle.

enemies.name: Lightning Juggernaut
descriptions: Uses energy damage at close range.
